description: Deployed gate_se seed42 finetuned on a leak-excluded 10k subset of the 60k ISIC-archive library (epoch 1 of 8) with mixed supervision: 764 masked ISIC3B train at lambda=1 (CE+Dice) + 10k maskless at lambda=0.

finetune.data: 10k leak-excluded 60k (5000 benign + 5000 malignant); pHash<=5 to the 900 train+val and the 376 test excluded (1930 files)
finetune.optimizer: Adam backbone 1e-4 / loc_head 3e-3, cosine to 1e-6, AMP

metrics_heldout_ood_3000.note: broad ISIC-archive slice disjoint from train and test

preprocessing: gating_service.py training-exact recipe (DullRazor NO MORPH_OPEN, Shades-of-Grey p=6, 224 pad, ImageNet norm)
